records.source: Hi, honey! If I knew more about farm work I'd help you out more. Sorry!#$e#I'll be thinking of you.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal! Kung mas marami lang akong alam sa gawain sa bukid, mas matutulungan sana kita. Pasensiya na!#$e#Lagi kitang iisipin.$h

records.source: I'm just going to do some dusting over here. That should help you out, right?#$e#*phew*... it's hot out here.
records.translation: Magpupunas lang ako ng alikabok dito. Makatutulong iyon sa iyo, hindi ba?#$e#*Hay*... mainit dito sa labas.

records.source: Don't overwork yourself, dear.#$e#Make sure and take a break every now and then, or get something to eat.$h
records.translation: Huwag mong pagurin nang sobra ang sarili mo, mahal.#$e#Tiyaking magpahinga paminsan-minsan, o kumuha ng makakain.$h

records.source: I like being out here. It's a good place to think about new inventions.$h#$e#I'm still hoping to come up with something to help you out in your work.
records.translation: Gusto kong narito sa labas. Magandang lugar ito para mag-isip ng mga bagong imbensiyon.$h#$e#Umaasa pa rin akong makalikha ng bagay na makatutulong sa trabaho mo.

records.source: I'm just going to hang out here, okay?#$e#There's a lot of interesting bugs and things out here. *chuckle*$h
records.translation: Tatambay lang ako rito, ayos lang?#$e#Maraming kawili-wiling kulisap at iba pang bagay dito. *tawa nang mahina*$h

records.source: Looks like a good day to work on my tan, don't you think, sweetheart?$h
records.translation: Mukhang magandang araw para pagandahin ang pagkakaitim ng balat ko, hindi ba, mahal?$h

records.source: Wow, this is great! I'm really starting to enjoy life on the farm, @.$h#$e#This is the life I've always dreamed of.$l
records.translation: Wow, napakaganda nito! Talagang nagugustuhan ko na ang buhay sa bukid, @.$h#$e#Ito ang buhay na lagi kong pinangarap.$l

records.source: I'm really happy on our little farm, @.$h
records.translation: Napakasaya ko sa munting bukid natin, @.$h

records.source: This is so different from my old life, but I'm really starting to like it.$h#$e#I feel like I really belong here.$l
records.translation: Ibang-iba ito sa dati kong buhay, pero talagang nagugustuhan ko na.$h#$e#Pakiramdam ko, dito talaga ako nababagay.$l

records.source: This is so much nicer than being cooped up in the clinic all day.$l#$e#I love watching you on the farm... hehe
records.translation: Mas maganda ito kaysa makulong sa klinika buong araw.$l#$e#Gustong-gusto kitang pagmasdan sa bukid... hehe

records.source: Today, I'm going to continue writing my new novel. What better place than our wonderful farm?$h#$e#This is perfect.$l
records.translation: Ngayon, ipagpapatuloy ko ang pagsulat ng bago kong nobela. May mas mainam pa bang lugar kaysa sa kahanga-hangang bukid natin?$h#$e#Perpekto ito.$l

records.source: I'm going to get a bunch of exercise today! Haha! I love living on a farm.$h
records.translation: Mag-eehersisyo ako nang husto ngayon! Haha! Gustung-gusto kong mamuhay sa bukid.$h

records.source: Hey, look at those puffy clouds in the sky, honey!$h#$e#I'm going to watch those for a while, if you don't mind.
records.translation: Hoy, tingnan mo ang malalambot na ulap sa langit, mahal!$h#$e#Pagmamasdan ko muna ang mga iyon kung ayos lang sa iyo.

records.source: I dunno if my lungs can handle this freshness. I'm still used to JojaAir.
records.translation: Hindi ko alam kung kaya ng mga baga ko ang ganitong kasariwaan. Sanay pa rin ako sa JojaAir.

records.source: You're doing great work, @. Keep it up.
records.translation: Mahusay ang ginagawa mo, @. Ipagpatuloy mo lang.

records.source: I have to go into the clinic today. Have a nice day, okay?
records.translation: Kailangan kong pumunta sa klinika ngayon. Magandang araw sa iyo, ha?

records.source: I have to go into town today. Don't work too hard, and eat something good for lunch!$h
records.translation: Kailangan kong pumunta sa bayan ngayon. Huwag masyadong magpakapagod, at kumain ka ng masarap sa tanghalian!$h

records.source: I have to leave for work soon. I'll see you tonight. I'll be thinking of you!$h
records.translation: Kailangan kong umalis para sa trabaho maya-maya. Magkita tayo mamayang gabi. Iisipin kita!$h

records.source: #$c .5#Hi, honey. How was your day?#$e#*Phew*... I'm exhausted...$s#$e#My patients are still healthy, so it was a good day.
records.translation: #$c .5#Kumusta, mahal. Kumusta ang araw mo?#$e#*Hay*... Pagod na pagod ako...$s#$e#Malulusog pa rin ang mga pasyente ko, kaya magandang araw iyon.

records.source: #$c .5#Good evening. My day was fine, thanks! How was yours?$h#$e#Jas and Vincent weren't behaving very well today. I'm still all wound up...
records.translation: #$c .5#Magandang gabi. Maayos ang araw ko, salamat! Kumusta ang sa iyo?$h#$e#Hindi gaanong nagpakabait sina Jas at Vincent ngayon. Balisa pa rin ako...

records.source: #$c .5#Well, it was just another boring day at the clinic.#$e#Hey. Did you have a more exciting day than me? I hope so.#$e#$c .5#Well, it's time to kick back and relax. Did you leave me any dinner?#$e#I'm just looking forward to bed-time.$h
records.translation: #$c .5#Isa na namang nakakabagot na araw sa klinika.#$e#Hoy. Mas kapana-panabik ba ang araw mo kaysa sa akin? Sana nga.#$e#$c .5#Oras na para magpahinga nang maayos. May itinira ka bang hapunan para sa akin?#$e#Gusto ko na lang talagang matulog.$h

records.source: Have you spent any time with %kid1 today?
records.translation: Nakasama mo ba si %kid1 ngayon?

records.source: I wonder if %kid1 will grow up to be a farmer like you?
records.translation: Magiging magsasakang tulad mo kaya si %kid1 paglaki?

records.source: Don't worry, I'll feed %kid1 today. You can just focus on running the farm.
records.translation: Huwag kang mag-alala, ako ang magpapakain kay %kid1 ngayon. Magtuon ka na lang sa pagpapatakbo ng bukid.

records.source: Life's a lot different now that we have a child.
records.translation: Ibang-iba na ang buhay ngayong may anak na tayo.

records.source: I already gave %kid1 and %kid2 their breakfast. They were hungry!
records.translation: Naipaghanda ko na ng almusal sina %kid1 at %kid2. Gutom na gutom sila!

records.source: We have to make sure and give %kid1 a lot of attention now that we have %kid2. We don't want any jealousy between them.
records.translation: Kailangan nating tiyaking mabigyan pa rin ng maraming pansin si %kid1 ngayong narito na si %kid2. Ayaw nating magselos sila sa isa’t isa.

records.source: You know, I think %kid2 has your nose.
records.translation: Alam mo, sa tingin ko, namana ni %kid2 ang ilong mo.

records.source: A nice house, two wonderful kids, and a beautiful plot of land. What's left?
records.translation: Magandang bahay, dalawang kahanga-hangang anak, at magandang lote. Ano pa ang kulang?

records.source: It's hard to believe we're finally married...$l
records.translation: Mahirap paniwalaang kasal na tayo sa wakas...$l

records.source: You know, I always had a feeling we'd be together some day.$l
records.translation: Alam mo, noon pa man ay pakiramdam ko, magkakatuluyan tayo balang araw.$l

records.source: Are you enjoying the married life, @?#$e#I am.$l
records.translation: Nasisiyahan ka ba sa buhay-may-asawa, @?#$e#Ako, oo.$l

records.source: Wow, you look really handsome today!$l^Wow, you look beautiful today.$l
records.translation: Wow, napakaguwapo mo ngayon!$l^Wow, napakaganda mo ngayon.$l

records.source: This place is my home now... I'm happy here.$l
records.translation: Tahanan ko na ngayon ang lugar na ito... Masaya ako rito.$l

records.source: I was just admiring my wedding amulet... The shell is flawless. It must have cost you a fortune!$l
records.translation: Hinahangaan ko lang ang anting-anting ko sa kasal... Walang bahid ang kabibe. Siguradong napakamahal nito!$l

records.source: Be careful out there! Sometimes I worry about you falling into a mine shaft.
records.translation: Mag-ingat ka roon! Kung minsan, nag-aalala akong baka mahulog ka sa isang lagusan ng minahan.

records.source: @? I just want to say that I appreciate all the hard work you do for our household.$h
records.translation: @? Gusto ko lang sabihing pinahahalagahan ko ang lahat ng pagsisikap mo para sa sambahayan natin.$h

records.source: Don't worry about me... I know you've got a lot of responsibilities outside of the house. I'm fine in here by myself!$l
records.translation: Huwag kang mag-alala sa akin... Alam kong marami kang pananagutan sa labas ng bahay. Ayos lang akong mag-isa rito!$l

records.source: Oh, I'm not bored... I'm just enjoying what we have here.#$e#It's a simple life, but I like it.$h
records.translation: Ah, hindi ako naiinip... Nasisiyahan lang ako sa mayroon tayo rito.#$e#Payak ang buhay, pero gusto ko ito.$h

records.source: I hope you'll still like me when I'm old and gray.$s
records.translation: Sana ay magugustuhan mo pa rin ako kapag matanda na ako at ubanin.$s

records.source: Do you think your grandpa would be proud of the work we've done?
records.translation: Sa tingin mo, ipagmamalaki kaya ng Lolo mo ang mga nagawa natin?

records.source: Taking a break? I guess being a farmer is easier than I thought...
records.translation: Nagpapahinga ka? Mukhang mas madali pala ang pagiging magsasaka kaysa sa akala ko...

records.source: If you go into town, make sure and say hi to everyone for me.
records.translation: Kung pupunta ka sa bayan, pakikumusta mo ako sa lahat.

records.source: I'll do the laundry tomorrow morning before you get up... that way you won't have any down-time.
records.translation: Ako na ang maglalaba bukas ng umaga bago ka bumangon... nang hindi ka maantala.

records.source: Are we doing okay on money, @?
records.translation: Sapat pa ba ang pera natin, @?

records.source: I wonder what everyone in town is doing today?
records.translation: Ano kaya ang ginagawa ngayon ng lahat sa bayan?

records.source: I don't really feel like doing anything today.
records.translation: Wala talaga akong ganang gumawa ng anuman ngayon.

records.source: No matter how much I clean, the house keeps getting dirty again.#$e#I guess farms can be kind of dirty.
records.translation: Kahit gaano ako kadalas maglinis, nadudumihan pa rin ang bahay.#$e#Siguro ay medyo marumi talaga ang mga bukid.

records.source: I wonder if we'll live here our entire lives?
records.translation: Dito kaya tayo titira habang-buhay?

records.source: ...Do you still love me?$s
records.translation: ...Mahal mo pa rin ba ako?$s

records.source: *sigh*... Maybe we got married too young.$s
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*... Baka masyado tayong bata nang magpakasal.$s

records.source: Are you still happy with me?$s
records.translation: Masaya ka pa rin ba sa piling ko?$s

records.source: Did I do something wrong? You've been acting different lately.$s
records.translation: May mali ba akong nagawa? Iba ang kilos mo nitong mga huli.$s

records.source: Do you ever wonder what else is out there?$s
records.translation: Napapaisip ka ba kung ano pa ang naghihintay sa labas?$s

records.source: You used to be romantic... what happened?$s#$e#I know I'm not as young as I used to be... is that what you married me for?$a
records.translation: Dati, napakaromantiko mo... ano ang nangyari?$s#$e#Alam kong hindi na ako kasimbata ng dati... iyon ba ang dahilan kung bakit mo ako pinakasalan?$a

records.source: We only have one short life to live... is this the best way to do it?$s
records.translation: Iisa lang ang maikling buhay natin... ito ba ang pinakamainam na paraan para gugulin iyon?$s

records.source: I used to be your sweetie... now you only seem to put up with me when I make a hot dinner.$s
records.translation: Dati, ako ang mahal mo... ngayon, parang tinitiis mo lang ako kapag naghahanda ako ng mainit na hapunan.$s

records.source: You've been so cold to me lately...$s
records.translation: Napakalamig ng pakikitungo mo sa akin nitong mga huli...$s

records.source: I wonder if I could've done better.$s
records.translation: May mas mabuti kaya sana akong napili?$s

records.source: Well, a new year has arrived. Do you have a plan for what you want to accomplish this year?#$e#I feel pretty hopeful.
records.translation: Aba, dumating na ang bagong taon. May plano ka ba sa gusto mong makamit ngayong taon?#$e#Malaki ang pag-asa ko.

records.source: Now that winter's over, we've got lots of productive weather to look forward to.
records.translation: Ngayong tapos na ang taglamig, marami tayong maaasahang araw na mainam para maging produktibo.

records.source: I hope you've been practicing your moves... tomorrow is the flower dance!
records.translation: Sana nagsasanay ka na ng mga galaw mo... Sayaw ng mga Bulaklak bukas!

records.source: Make sure you don't get a heat stroke, dear.#$e#Drink plenty of water and don't overwork yourself.
records.translation: Tiyaking hindi ka tamaan ng heatstroke, mahal.#$e#Uminom ng maraming tubig at huwag magpakapagod.

records.source: Sorry if I smell... I was sweating all night in the heat.
records.translation: Pasensiya na kung may amoy ako... Buong gabi akong pinagpawisan sa init.

records.source: It's summer... that means the house is full of flies.#$e#Don't worry, I'll take care of them.
records.translation: Tag-init na... ibig sabihin, puno ng langaw ang bahay.#$e#Huwag kang mag-alala, ako ang bahala sa mga iyon.

records.source: This weather feels pretty nice after the heat of summer.
records.translation: Napakasarap ng panahong ito matapos ang init ng tag-init.

records.source: Winter's just around the corner. We need to double check the heating system, turn off the valves, and check all the insulation in the house.#$e#Don't worry, I'll take care of it all.
records.translation: Malapit na ang taglamig. Kailangan nating suriin muli ang sistema ng pampainit, isara ang mga balbula, at tingnan ang lahat ng insulasyon sa bahay.#$e#Huwag kang mag-alala, ako ang bahala sa lahat.

records.source: Have you figured out what you're going to use for our grange display tomorrow?
records.translation: Napag-isipan mo na ba kung ano ang ilalagay mo sa Tanghalang Bukid natin bukas?

records.source: Should we go to the Spirit's Eve festival tomorrow night?
records.translation: Pumunta kaya tayo sa pagdiriwang ng Bisperas ng mga Espiritu bukas ng gabi?

records.source: Brrr.... It's cold. I guess winter has arrived.
records.translation: Brrr... Malamig. Mukhang dumating na ang taglamig.
